title: Account-Age Relief on Home Comfort Financing Post-Promotional Interest
content:
| Whole months from the funded date to the date of handling | Post-promotional account-age relief |
|---|---|
| at least 36 | 10 percent |
| at least 12 but fewer than 36 | 5 percent |
| fewer than 12 | zero |

*Home Comfort Financing — post-promotional interest, relief by account age.* The post-promotional account-age relief is 10 percent when the account funded at least 36 whole months before the date of handling, 5 percent when it funded at least 12 but fewer than 36 whole months before, and zero when it funded fewer than 12 whole months before.

The relief is part of the post-promotional relief percentage: the post-promotional reliefs are added together and the plan's post-promotional APR is reduced once by that total; the reliefs never act one after another.

**Notes to the table.**

1. Months are whole months since the funded date; a part month does not count.
2. At 12 whole months the relief moves from zero to 5 percent; at 36 whole months it moves from 5 to 10 percent.
